projects.title: AI-Powered SRE Agent
projects.summary: An AI agent that triages production alerts for Trafikverket's operations teams by reading the metrics, logs and source code behind an alert and proposing a diagnosis with next steps.

projects.title: Sensor Classification
projects.summary: Classifying building and energy sensor types from metadata and time-series measurements at Axiogreen.

projects.title: Data-Poisoning Attacks on DistilBERT
projects.summary: Controlled experiments measuring how label-flipping and backdoor attacks degrade a DistilBERT sentiment classifier on IMDB, with IsolationForest in embedding space tested as a defence.

projects.title: Hospital Readmission Prediction
projects.summary: An end-to-end pipeline predicting 30-day readmission risk, comparing supervised and semi-supervised models.
